note: The maintained Primer mapping. seed: the upstream variable each ModeSeed color comes from, and the opaque role an alpha value is flattened over. emit: each GitHub variable the compiler writes and its resolved role, or why it is exempt from pair checks. inheritedPairs: emitted foreground and background variables GitHub's stylesheets paint together that the matrix does not name. readableWith: a background role emitted only while the named foreground reads on it, otherwise the fallback role. readableOn: a foreground role emitted only while it reads on every named background, otherwise the first fallback that does. brandFooter: the Primer Brand footer variables. brandPage: the core Primer Brand variables on recognized Brand page islands. rolePairs: the pair-matrix and inherited pair IDs covering each emitted role.
